metadata.case_title: MYAKALA DHARMARAJAM & ORS. ETC. vs THE STATE OF TELANGANA & ANR.
metadata.case_number: Criminal Appeal Nos. 1974- 1975 of 2019 (@ SLP (Crl.) Nos.8882-8883 of 2019)
metadata.summary: Respondent No.2 filed a complaint under various sections of the IPC alleging that the Appellants attacked her husband resulting in his death. The Appellants were granted bail by the Sessions Judge with certain conditions. However, the High Court cancelled the bail citing reasons of not considering criminal antecedents and witness tampering. The Supreme Court emphasized the factors to be considered while granting bail and held that the Sessions Court's decision was not perverse. The complaint of witness tampering was found vague, leading to the Appeals being allowed and the High Court's judgment being set aside.
